Definition: Pelatjah, the name of four Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Four men bear the name Pelatiah. One was a prince of the people at the east gate, and Ezekiel watched him fall dead as he prophesied, and cried out for the remnant of Israel. Another, a son of Ishi, led five hundred Simeonites to Mount Seir as their captain.
TheologicalSignificance: I take it that a name can carry both judgment and courage: one Pelatiah died under the word of the Lord, and another led his men into the hill country, and God remembers both.
